add_definitions(
    -DWIN32
    -DNDEBUG=
    -DUSE_WIN32_FILEIO
    -DTIF_PLATFORM_CONSOLE)

spec2def(libtiff.dll libtiff.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# libtiff.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/libtiff-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C, kept on disk:
#mkg3states.c
#tif_jbig.c
#tif_jpeg.c   # off with JPEG_SUPPORT — see tiffconf.h
#tif_lzma.c
#tif_ojpeg.c
#tif_stream.cxx
#tif_webp.c
#tif_zstd.c
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(libtiff_shims OBJECT tif_aux.c tif_close.c tif_codec.c tif_color.c tif_compress.c tif_dir.c tif_dirinfo.c tif_dirread.c tif_dirwrite.c tif_dumpmode.c tif_error.c tif_extension.c tif_fax3.c tif_fax3sm.c tif_flush.c tif_getimage.c tif_hash_set.c tif_luv.c tif_lzw.c tif_next.c tif_open.c tif_packbits.c tif_pixarlog.c tif_predict.c tif_print.c tif_read.c tif_strip.c tif_swab.c tif_thunder.c tif_tile.c tif_version.c tif_warning.c tif_win32.c tif_write.c tif_zip.c)
target_link_libraries(libtiff_shims PRIVATE zlib getopt liblibjpeg libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_include_directories(libtiff_shims PUBLIC ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libtiff/include)
if(MSVC)
    remove_target_compile_option(libtiff_shims "/we4311")
endif()
if(MSVC)
    remove_target_compile_option(libtiff_shims "/we4312")
endif()
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(libtiff_shims PRIVATE
            -Wno-unused-but-set-variable
            -Wno-array-parameter)
endif()
set(LIBTIFF_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libgetopt.a)
add_cargo_module(libtiff libtiff-cargo libtiff.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS libtiff_shims ${LIBTIFF_REUSED} psdk)
